cards.whyItMatters: 期望分位数兼具一致性与可诱导性，但长期缺乏类似CVaR的Wasserstein可处理表示，限制了其在分布鲁棒多期组合优化中的应用。该工作通过包络定理打通了这一障碍，并给出可求解的参数线性规划重构，使决策者能在保持期望分位数风险度量优点的同时纳入Wasserstein模糊集；同时，对地面度量决定组合集中度或分散度的刻画，提示模糊集建模中选择地面度量并非中性，可能实质性影响最优组合结构。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Expectiles combine coherence and elicitability, but the lack of a CVaR-like tractable Wasserstein representation has limited their use in distributionally robust multi-period portfolio optimization. The envelope theorem removes this obstacle and yields a solvable parametric linear programming reformulation, allowing decision-makers to retain the merits of expectile risk measures while incorporating Wasserstein ambiguity sets. Moreover, the characterization of how the ground metric determines portfolio concentration or diversification indicates that the choice of ground metric in ambiguity-set modeling is not neutral and may materially affect optimal portfolio structure.
cards.summaryEn: Expectiles are the only law-invariant risk measures that are both coherent and elicitable, yet unlike CVaR they lack a tractable Wasserstein reformulation. The authors establish an envelope theorem for worst-case expectiles, showing it equals the unique root of a worst-case expectation with a two-piece affine integrand, and reformulate a multi-period tri-level mean-expectile portfolio problem as four parametric linear programs with constraints. They report four structural properties and find in out-of-sample FTSE constituent data that the expectile model outperforms a CVaR model matched on ambiguity set, radius, ground metric, and trade-off weight across all nine parameter cells.
keyPointsEn: An envelope theorem for worst-case expectiles is established, proving it equals the unique root of a worst-case expectation with a two-piece affine integrand, enabling direct application of standard Wasserstein duality.

A multi-period tri-level mean-expectile portfolio problem is reformulated as four parametric linear programs with constraints, and four structural properties are characterized: an endogenously damped price of robustness, a decision-dependent critical radius, exact recovery of the nominal model at zero ambiguity, and how the Wasserstein ground metric determines whether the limiting portfolio becomes more concentrated or more diversified.

In numerical experiments on 90 FTSE constituents over 3,341 out-of-sample trading days, the expectile model outperforms a CVaR model matched on ambiguity set, radius, ground metric, and trade-off weight in all nine parameter cells, with significant differences whenever the radius is non-trivial.
cards.limitations: 本文的结论建立在特定Wasserstein模糊集与期望分位数设定之上，包络定理与重构的有效性依赖其假设条件；数值证据仅来自90只FTSE成分股和3341个样本外交易日，样本范围与市场代表性有限，不能直接外推到其他资产类别、市场或时期。作者报告的四个结构性质是模型的理论性质，其实际显著性受参数与半径取值影响；实验中的对比限于在模糊集、半径、地面度量和权衡权重上匹配的CVaR模型，未涵盖其他风险度量或替代建模方式。地面度量导致的退化现象虽在实验中得到确认，但其一般性与稳健性仍需更多独立检验。
cards.descriptionEn: The paper develops an envelope theorem for worst-case expectiles, characterizing the worst-case expectile over a Wasserstein ambiguity set as the unique root of a worst-case expectation with a two-piece affine integrand. This overcomes the absence of a Rockafellar-Uryasev representation for expectiles, which has hindered direct Wasserstein duality. Using the result, the authors reformulate a multi-period tri-level mean-expectile portfolio problem as four parametric linear pro
cards.summary: 期望分位数是唯一兼具一致性与可诱导性的律不变风险度量，但不同于CVaR，它缺乏可处理的Wasserstein重构表示。作者为最坏情况期望分位数建立包络定理，将其转化为两段仿射被积函数的最坏情况期望的唯一根，并据此把多期三层均值-期望分位数组合问题重构为四个带约束的参数线性规划。作者报告了四个结构性质，并在FTSE成分股样本外数据中观察到期望分位数模型在全部九个参数格上优于匹配模糊集、半径、地面度量和权衡权重的CVaR模型。
cards.originalTitle: Multi-period Mean-Expectile Portfolio Optimization under Wasserstein Ambiguity: Reformulation, Degeneracy and the Role of the Ground Metric
cards.titleEn: Multi-period Mean-Expectile Portfolio Optimization under Wasserstein Ambiguity: Reformulation, Degeneracy and the Ground Metric
cards.limitationsEn: The conclusions rest on a specific Wasserstein ambiguity set and expectile setting, and the validity of the envelope theorem and reformulation depends on their assumptions. Numerical evidence comes only from 90 FTSE constituents over 3,341 out-of-sample trading days, so the sample scope and market representativeness are limited and cannot be directly extrapolated to other asset classes, markets, or periods. The four structural properties are theoretical properties of the model, and their practical significance depends on parameter and radius values. The experimental comparison is restricted to a CVaR model matched on ambiguity set, radius, ground metric, and trade-off weight, and does not cover other risk measures or alternative modeling approaches. Although the ground-metric degeneracy is confirmed in the experiments, its generality and robustness require further independent testing.
keyPoints: 提出最坏情况期望分位数的包络定理，证明其等于两段仿射被积函数最坏情况期望的唯一根，使标准Wasserstein对偶可直接应用。
将多期三层均值-期望分位数组合问题重构为四个带约束的参数线性规划，并刻画内生阻尼的稳健性价格、决策依赖的临界半径、零模糊下名义模型的精确恢复以及地面度量对极限组合集中度或分散度的决定作用。
在90只FTSE成分股、3341个样本外交易日上的数值实验中，期望分位数模型在全部九个参数格上优于在模糊集、半径、地面度量和权衡权重上匹配的CVaR模型，且在半径非平凡时差异显著。
cards.description: 本文提出一个包络定理，将Wasserstein模糊集下的最坏情况期望分位数刻画为两段仿射被积函数的最坏情况期望的唯一根，从而克服期望分位数缺乏Rockafellar-Uryasev表示、难以直接应用Wasserstein对偶的困难。基于该结果，作者将多期三层均值-期望分位数组合问题重构为四个带约束的参数线性规划，并刻画了模型的结构性质与退化现象，为多期分布鲁棒组合优化提供了可处理的期望分位数建模途径。
cards.title: Wasserstein模糊集下多期均值-期望分位数组合优化

cards.whyItMatters: 该方法帮助从业者在数据稀缺、模型容量受限等冷启动条件下判断何时值得投入外部先验标注，为信用评分等金融机器学习场景提供了可操作的先验知识利用框架。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This method helps practitioners decide when investing in external prior annotation is worthwhile under cold-start conditions such as data scarcity and limited model capacity, offering an actionable framework for leveraging prior knowledge in credit scoring and other financial machine learning settings.
cards.summaryEn: Cold-start credit scoring struggles with scarce labeled data, weak features, and limited model capacity, while standard defenses rely only on the same limited data. The authors propose Ranking Prior Alignment, which integrates external ranking priors into neural and tree-based models via a temperature-scaled KL divergence loss without requiring the external model at inference. On an industrial dataset, MIL alignment achieves 7/7 positive evaluation cells at 3K bags and XGBoost ablation achieves 9/9 positive metrics at 300 bags; public Amex validation shows 5/5 positive folds with average Delta AUC of +0.041, and authors observe an inverse-scaling pattern where gains grow as data, capacity, and feature quality decrease.
keyPointsEn: The framework is model-agnostic and prior-source-independent, unifying neural and tree architectures such as MIL attention and XGBoost custom objectives, and requires no external model at inference.
On an industrial dataset of over 1.5M merchants, MIL alignment achieves 7/7 positive evaluation cells at 3K bags and XGBoost ablation achieves 9/9 positive metrics at 300 bags.
Cross-dataset validation on public Amex shows 5/5 positive folds with average Delta AUC of +0.041; the XGBoost instantiation tolerates annotation noise up to eta=0.5.
cards.limitations: 摘要仅报告了工业数据集和公开Amex上的实验结果，未提供完整实验设置、统计显著性检验或经济意义评估；逆缩放模式仍需更多独立数据和业务场景验证；收益量级在部分设置下较小，实际部署价值取决于具体冷启动条件。
cards.descriptionEn: This study proposes Ranking Prior Alignment, a framework that distills external ranking priors from domain experts, teacher models, or LLMs into any scoring model via a temperature-scaled KL divergence loss, addressing when external priors are useful in cold-start credit scoring.
cards.summary: 冷启动信用评分面临标注数据稀缺、特征不成熟、模型容量受限等困难，标准防御方法只能依赖有限的同源数据。作者提出Ranking Prior Alignment框架，以温度缩放KL散度将外部排序先验整合进神经和树模型，推理阶段无需外部模型。工业商户数据上MIL对齐在3K样本取得7/7正向评估单元，XGBoost消融在300样本取得9/9正向指标，公开Amex数据集5/5正向折，平均Delta AUC为+0.041；作者还观察到对齐收益随数据量、模型容量和特征质量下降而增大的逆缩放模式。
cards.originalTitle: Ranking Prior Alignment for Credit Risk Modeling: When Do External Priors Matter?
cards.titleEn: Ranking Prior Alignment Framework: When Do External Priors Help in Cold-Start Credit Risk Modeling?
cards.limitationsEn: The abstract reports experiments only on an industrial dataset and public Amex, without full experimental settings, statistical significance tests, or economic evaluation; the inverse-scaling pattern requires further validation across independent datasets and business scenarios; and the magnitude of gains is small in some settings, so practical deployment value depends on specific cold-start conditions.
keyPoints: 框架模型无关且先验来源无关，统一了MIL注意力与XGBoost自定义目标等神经和树架构，推理时不需要外部模型。
工业数据集超过150万商户，MIL对齐在3K样本上达到7/7正向评估单元，XGBoost消融在300样本上达到9/9正向指标。
公开Amex跨数据集验证为5/5正向折，平均Delta AUC为+0.041；XGBoost实例可容忍标注噪声至eta=0.5。
cards.description: 该研究提出排序先验对齐框架，将领域专家、教师模型或大语言模型提供的外部排序先验通过温度缩放的KL散度损失蒸馏到任意评分模型中，回答在冷启动信用评分场景下外部先验知识何时有效这一实践问题。
cards.title: 排序先验对齐框架：冷启动信用评分中外部先验知识何时起作用

cards.whyItMatters: 该方法为长文本信息利用提供了一种可部署的离线特征工程思路，在保持结构化模型在线效率的同时，通过LLM引导的程序搜索自动构造特征，并在风控场景中报告了指标提升，可能减少人工特征设计负担。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The method offers a deployable offline feature engineering approach for using long-text information, maintaining online efficiency of structured models while automatically constructing features via LLM-guided program search, and reports metric gains in risk-control settings that may reduce manual feature design effort.
cards.summaryEn: Industrial risk control relies on structured models, leaving long-text information underused; manual feature engineering is costly and online LLM calls are impractical. LLM-BlockFE lets an LLM search executable feature programs offline, evaluates them with a downstream model, and introduces block-level rollback and interleaved multi-trajectory search to avoid greedy suboptimal solutions. The paper reports absolute AUC improvements of 0.0069 to 0.0358 across four datasets and KS improvements of 0.02 to 1.56 percentage points across five deployed financial risk-control applications.
keyPointsEn: LLM-BlockFE converts long text into executable feature programs offline, eliminating LLM calls during online inference and reducing deployment cost.
It uses a block-level rollback mechanism with depth-calibrated credit allocation and interleaves multiple independent search trajectories to reduce redundant exploration.

On two public and two private datasets, AUC improves by 0.0069 to 0.0358 absolute over the strongest baseline; on five deployed financial risk-control applications, KS improves by 0.02 to 1.56 percentage points absolute.
cards.limitations: 效果仅在文中所述的2个公开和2个私有数据集以及5个已上线金融风控应用上验证，AUC提升幅度有限，KS提升范围较宽；未说明跨领域、跨语言或跨时间泛化能力，也未分析LLM调用成本与搜索开销，实际部署需结合业务验证。
cards.descriptionEn: LLM-BlockFE uses an LLM offline to convert long text into executable feature programs so that no LLM call is needed at online inference; block-level rollback and interleaved multi-trajectory search improve feature quality, with AUC gains of 0.0069 to 0.0358 on public and private datasets.
cards.summary: 工业风控依赖结构化模型，但长文本信息未被充分利用，人工特征工程成本高，在线调用LLM不现实。LLM-BlockFE让LLM离线搜索可执行特征程序，用下游模型评估，并引入块级回滚与多轨迹交错搜索防止贪心陷入局部最优。据文中报告，在四个数据集上AUC绝对提升0.0069至0.0358，五个上线金融风控应用KS绝对提升0.02至1.56个百分点。
cards.originalTitle: Long Text to Predictive Features: LLM-Guided Blockwise Feature Engineering via Executable Program Search
cards.titleEn: Long Text to Predictive Features: LLM-Guided Executable Program Search for Offline Feature Engineering in Risk Control
cards.limitationsEn: Validation is limited to the two public and two private datasets and five deployed financial risk-control applications described; AUC gains are modest and the KS improvement range is wide. Generalization across domains, languages, or time is not shown, and LLM call cost and search overhead are not analyzed; practical deployment requires business-specific validation.
keyPoints: LLM-BlockFE离线将长文本转为可执行特征程序，在线推理无需调用LLM，降低部署成本。
采用块级回滚机制和深度校准信用分配，并交错推进多条独立搜索轨迹，减少冗余探索。
在2个公开和2个私有数据集上，AUC比最强基线绝对提升0.0069至0.0358；5个上线金融风控应用KS绝对提升0.02至1.56个百分点。
cards.description: 提出LLM-BlockFE框架，利用LLM离线将长文本转化为可执行特征程序，避免在线推理时调用LLM；通过块级回滚与多轨迹交错搜索提升特征质量，在公开与私有数据集上AUC提升0.0069至0.0358。
cards.title: 长文本特征工程：LLM引导可执行程序搜索，离线构建特征供风控模型

cards.whyItMatters: 该工作为量子神经网络在金融回归预测中的架构设计提供了系统性的比较基准，并首次以较大规模刻画了近 term 量子设备上的噪声敏感性，有助于研究者理解哪些电路设计选择真正影响性能与硬件可行性。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work provides a systematic benchmark for QNN architecture design in financial regression forecasting and offers a large-scale characterization of noise sensitivity on near-term quantum devices, helping researchers understand which circuit design choices truly affect performance and hardware feasibility.
cards.summaryEn: The authors conducted a large-scale grid search comparing QNN configurations for financial time series regression forecasting, finding that gate selection and arrangement are more critical than raw parameter count, and that entanglement is a system-level property of the full circuit. The best configuration achieved an R² of 0.985 on the case study, outperforming a classical BiLSTM baseline. Execution on the IQM Emerald device showed that gate errors and decoherence are significant barriers to practical deployment, with gate selection and circuit depth identified as key determinants of hardware noise resilience.
keyPointsEn: A grid search over 1,368 QNN configurations covering encoding, ansatz, qubit count, layer depth, and cost function.
Gate selection and arrangement are more critical to model success than raw parameter count, and entanglement emerges as a system-level property of the full circuit.
The best QNN configuration achieved R²=0.985 in the case study, surpassing a classical BiLSTM baseline; real hardware noise from gate errors and decoherence poses a deployment barrier.
cards.limitations: 研究仅以英镑/美元即期汇率为单一案例，结论对其他金融资产或时间序列的泛化性未经检验；基准测试基于特定网格搜索范围与IQM Emerald设备，硬件噪声结论可能随设备与校准状态变化；结果反映的是特定实验设定下的表现，不构成投资建议或实际部署保证。
cards.descriptionEn: This study presents a large-scale systematic evaluation of quantum neural network (QNN) configurations for financial time series forecasting, using the GBP/USD spot exchange rate as a case study. A grid search over encoding methods, ansatz designs, qubit counts, layer depths, and cost functions yields 1,368 distinct configurations, assessed for prediction accuracy, computational cost, convergence behavior, and real quantum hardware noise. Its novelty lies in extending systema
cards.summary: 作者通过大规模网格搜索比较了量子神经网络在金融时间序列回归预测中的配置效果，发现门选择与排列比参数数量更关键，纠缠是全电路的系统级属性。最优配置在案例中达到R²=0.985，优于经典BiLSTM基线。作者在IQM Emerald设备上评估真实噪声，指出门错误和退相干是实际部署的重大障碍，门选择和电路深度是硬件噪声韧性的关键决定因素。
cards.originalTitle: Large-Scale Benchmarking of Quantum Neural Network Configurations for Financial Time Series Forecasting
cards.titleEn: Large-Scale Benchmarking of Quantum Neural Network Configurations for Financial Time Series Forecasting
cards.limitationsEn: The study uses only a single case of GBP/USD spot exchange rate, so generalizability to other financial assets or time series is untested; the benchmark is based on a specific grid search range and the IQM Emerald device, and hardware noise conclusions may vary with device and calibration state; results reflect performance under specific experimental settings and do not constitute investment advice or guarantees of practical deployment.
keyPoints: 对1,368种QNN配置进行网格搜索，覆盖编码、拟设、量子比特数、层深度和成本函数。
门选择与排列比原始参数数量对模型成功更关键，纠缠表现为全电路系统级性质。
最优QNN配置在案例中R²=0.985，超过经典BiLSTM基线；真实硬件噪声下门错误与退相干构成部署障碍。
cards.description: 该研究对量子神经网络（QNN）在金融时间序列预测中的多种配置进行大规模系统评估，以英镑/美元即期汇率为案例，通过网格搜索覆盖编码方法、拟设设计、量子比特数、层深度和成本函数，共1,368种配置，并考察预测精度、计算成本、收敛行为及真实量子硬件噪声影响。其新在于将QNN配置的系统比较从分类任务扩展到回归预测，并给出架构选择与噪声敏感性的实践指引。
cards.title: 量子神经网络配置的大规模基准测试：金融时间序列预测

cards.whyItMatters: 该工作强调，向强化学习智能体提供信息的质量与结构会影响交易表现和策略可解释性，为利用市场潜在信息的部分可观测交易问题提供了可比较的建模范式。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work highlights that the quality and structure of information supplied to a reinforcement learning agent affect trading performance and policy interpretability, offering a comparable modeling paradigm for partially observable trading problems that exploit latent market information.
cards.summaryEn: The paper studies optimal trading when the trading signal follows an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process with regime-switching parameters, formulated as a partially observable Markov decision process. The authors propose three RNN plus reinforcement learning schemes: directly encoding hidden states, using posterior regime probabilities, or using next-signal forecasts. Simulations and an empirical equity pairs trading application show that feeding posterior probabilities of the latent mean-reversion regime yields superior cumulative rewards and more interpretable strategies.
keyPointsEn: The problem is set as a partially observable Markov decision process where the trading signal is an OU process with regime-switching parameters.
Three RNN+RL schemes are proposed: one-step hidden state encoding, two-step posterior regime probability, and two-step signal forecasting.
In simulations with increasingly complex Markovian regime dynamics and in an empirical equity pairs trading application, the posterior regime probability scheme performs better.
cards.limitations: 结论基于作者设计的仿真和特定股票配对交易实证，未说明跨资产、跨市场或不同样本期的稳健性。论文为arXiv预印本，尚未明确经过同行评议。文中策略表现不代表实际投资建议，实际交易还受成本、流动性和市场冲击等因素影响。
cards.descriptionEn: This study applies recurrent neural network (RNN)-based reinforcement learning to optimal trading under partial observability. Its novelty lies in comparing three integration schemes: one-step direct encoding of GRU hidden states, two-step posterior regime probability, and two-step signal forecasting. The method that supplies posterior regime probabilities achieves higher cumulative rewards and more interpretable strategies.
cards.summary: 论文研究交易信号服从参数带状态切换的Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程时的最优交易问题，将其建模为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程。作者提出三种基于RNN与强化学习的方案，分别直接编码隐状态、使用后验状态概率、或使用下一信号预测。仿真与股票配对交易实证显示，向智能体输入隐均值回复状态的后验概率，可获得更高累积奖励和更可解释的策略。
cards.originalTitle: Deep reinforcement learning for optimal trading with partial information
cards.titleEn: Optimal Trading with Partial Information: RNN Reinforcement Learning Outperforms One-Step Encoding
cards.limitationsEn: The conclusions are based on the authors' designed simulations and a specific equity pairs trading empirical application, without establishing robustness across assets, markets, or different sample periods. The paper is an arXiv preprint and has not been confirmed as peer-reviewed. The reported strategy performance does not constitute investment advice, and real trading is also affected by costs, liquidity, and market impact.
keyPoints: 问题设定为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程，交易信号为带状态切换参数的OU过程。
提出三种RNN+RL方案：一步隐状态编码、两步后验状态概率、两步信号预测。
在复杂度递增的马尔可夫状态仿真和股票配对交易实证中，后验状态概率方案表现更优。
cards.description: 该研究将基于递归神经网络（RNN）的强化学习用于部分可观测市场中的最优交易。新意在于对比三种融合方案：一步直接编码GRU隐状态、两步使用后验状态概率、两步使用信号预测。结果表明提供后验状态概率的方法累积收益更高、策略更可解释。
cards.title: 部分信息最优交易：RNN强化学习优于一步编码

cards.whyItMatters: 该方法为测试时推理提供了一种高效的自适应计算分配策略，在不增加额外模型调用的情况下，将有限采样预算集中于难题，从而在低资源场景下显著提升推理性能，对实际部署有参考价值。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This method offers an efficient adaptive compute allocation strategy for test-time reasoning, concentrating a limited sampling budget on hard questions without extra model calls, thereby significantly improving reasoning performance in low-resource scenarios and providing practical reference for deployment.
cards.summaryEn: The paper notes that uniform allocation of sampling budget over-samples easy questions and under-explores hard ones. The authors propose UAB, which first generates a small fixed number of responses per question, uses vote entropy as a difficulty signal from answer disagreement, then allocates the remaining budget to questions with high disagreement via a marginal-greedy algorithm, with initial generations also contributing to the final vote. Experiments show UAB improves average accuracy by 2.3% over uniform allocation across five open-weight models and five reasoning benchmarks, with gains up to 5.5% and largest improvements in low-resource settings, meeting the target budget exactly without auxiliary models or extra LLM calls.
keyPointsEn: UAB estimates question difficulty from vote entropy of initial samples without auxiliary models or extra LLM calls.
It reallocates the remaining budget to questions with high answer disagreement via concave integer optimization, improving sampling efficiency.
It improves average accuracy by 2.3% across five models (1.5B-27B) and five reasoning benchmarks, with largest gains in low-resource settings.
cards.limitations: 摘要仅报告了平均准确率提升和部分基准增益，未说明在何种具体推理任务或模型上可能失效；投票熵作为难度信号的普适性、对答案空间连续或开放任务的适用性、以及与其他预算分配策略的对比均未提及；实验仅覆盖五个开源模型和五个基准，结论的泛化边界需进一步验证。
cards.descriptionEn: This work proposes an uncertainty-aware budget allocation framework that estimates question difficulty from vote entropy of initial samples and reallocates a fixed sampling budget via concave integer optimization, achieving an average accuracy gain of 2.3% across five models and five reasoning benchmarks without auxiliary model calls.
cards.summary: 论文指出均匀分配采样预算会导致简单问题过度采样、难题探索不足。作者提出UAB框架，先给每个问题少量生成，用投票熵衡量答案分歧作为难度信号，再将剩余预算集中分配给分歧大的问题，且这些初始生成也计入最终投票。实验表明UAB在五个开源模型和五个推理基准上平均准确率比均匀分配高2.3%，最高提升5.5%，低资源设置下增益最大，且精确满足目标预算，无需辅助模型或额外LLM调用。
cards.originalTitle: Uncertainty-Aware Budget Allocation for Adaptive Test-Time Reasoning
cards.titleEn: Uncertainty-Aware Budget Allocation Improves Efficiency of Language Model Reasoning
cards.limitationsEn: The abstract only reports average accuracy gains and some benchmark improvements, without specifying tasks or models where the method may fail; the generality of vote entropy as a difficulty signal, applicability to continuous or open-ended answer spaces, and comparison with other budget allocation strategies are not addressed; experiments cover only five open-weight models and five benchmarks, so generalization boundaries require further validation.
keyPoints: UAB利用初始采样的投票熵估计问题难度，无需额外模型或调用。
通过凹整数优化将剩余预算集中分配给答案分歧大的问题，提高采样效率。
在五个模型（1.5B-27B）和五个推理基准上平均准确率提升2.3%，低资源下增益最大。
cards.description: 该研究提出不确定性感知预算分配框架，利用初始采样答案的投票熵估计问题难度，通过凹整数优化重新分配固定采样预算，在五个模型和五个推理基准上平均准确率提升2.3%，且无需额外模型调用。
cards.title: 不确定性感知预算分配提升语言模型推理效率

cards.whyItMatters: 该工作为衡量AI智能体在长期对抗博弈中自主改进策略的能力提供了可重复的竞赛式评测框架，并指出当前系统在游戏理解、策略实现和长时程策略发展方面仍存在持续挑战。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The work provides a repeatable competition-style evaluation framework for measuring how well AI agents can autonomously improve strategies in long-running adversarial games, and it identifies persistent challenges in game understanding, strategy implementation, and long-horizon policy development.
cards.summaryEn: The paper formalizes Adversarial Heuristic Learning (AHL), in which AI agents act as learning engines that refine game policies and supporting software while model weights are fixed. The authors introduce AAArena, a benchmark of 12 authentic adversarial games and 1,920 archived human programs, with an evaluation protocol modeled on real-world game competitions. Among evaluated configurations, Opus5.5 with Claude Code earns 6 gold medals, but no configuration tops the remaining 6 human ladders; performance is generally weaker in games with more complex rule specifications.
keyPointsEn: Introduces Adversarial Heuristic Learning (AHL) and AAArena, covering 12 adversarial games and 1,920 archived human programs.
Under budget-constrained competition-style evaluation, the best configuration evaluated, Opus5.5 with Claude Code, earns 6 gold medals, but no configuration tops the remaining 6 human ladders.

Opponent selection, dense feedback, and both on-policy replays of one's own matches and off-policy replays of others' matches support policy improvement, while performance is weaker in games with more complex rules.
cards.limitations: 证据来自特定基准、固定预算与已评估的模型及工具配置，不能直接推广到其他游戏或开放环境；论文未证明AHL在所有对抗博弈中普遍有效，也未说明超越全部人类天梯所需条件；结果不构成对相关模型或投资价值的判断。
cards.descriptionEn: The study treats AI agents as learning engines that revise executable policies while model weights remain fixed, and evaluates them in long-running competitions across 12 adversarial games using a benchmark built from 1,920 archived human programs; its novelty lies in a repeatable competition-style protocol for measuring the boundaries of heuristic learning in adversarial games.
cards.summary: 论文形式化了对弈启发式学习（AHL），将AI智能体视为学习引擎，在固定模型权重下修订游戏策略与配套软件。作者构建了AAArena基准，包含12款真实对抗性游戏和1920个归档人类程序，并仿照真实游戏竞赛设计评估协议。实验显示评估配置中Opus5.5配合Claude Code获得6枚金牌，但没有任何配置能超越其余6个人类天梯；规则越复杂，表现普遍越弱。
cards.originalTitle: Can AI Agents Learn Their Way to the Top? Evaluating Heuristic Learning in a Long-Running Game Agent Competition
cards.titleEn: Evaluating Heuristic Learning of AI Agents in a Long-Running Game Agent Competition
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes from a specific benchmark, fixed budgets, and evaluated model and harness configurations, so it cannot be directly generalized to other games or open environments; the paper does not show that AHL is universally effective across adversarial games or specify the conditions needed to surpass all human ladders; the results do not constitute a judgment on the models' or investment value.
keyPoints: 提出对弈启发式学习（AHL）与AAArena基准，覆盖12款对抗性游戏和1920个归档人类程序。
在受预算约束的竞赛式评测中，评估配置最好成绩为Opus5.5配合Claude Code获得6枚金牌，但剩余6个人类天梯无人超越。
对手选择、密集反馈以及自身对局回放和他方对局回放均有助于策略改进，但复杂规则游戏表现更弱。
cards.description: 该研究将AI智能体作为学习引擎，在固定模型权重下通过改写可执行策略参与12款对抗性游戏的长期竞赛，并采用现实竞赛式评测协议；其新在于用归档人类程序构建可重复的竞技基准，用以衡量启发式学习在对抗博弈中的能力边界。
cards.title: AI智能体在长期博弈竞赛中争冠的启发式学习评测

cards.whyItMatters: 二手电子设备价格波动大、挂牌历史稀疏且价格分布非正态，与结构化金融市场差异显著。该基准为订阅制平台的定价与风险管理提供了跨模型、跨预测期的可比较证据，并提示中长期预测可优先考虑N-BEATS类深度架构，而短期预测中简单基线仍有参考价值。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Second-hand electronics exhibit high volatility, sparse listing histories, and non-normal price dynamics, differing markedly from structured financial markets. This benchmark provides comparable evidence across models and horizons for pricing and risk management on subscription-based platforms, suggesting that N-BEATS-like deep architectures may be preferable for medium- to long-term forecasting, while simple baselines remain informative at short horizons.
cards.summaryEn: The paper systematically benchmarks multi-horizon price forecasting for second-hand electronics, covering statistical models (ARIMA, ETS, Theta), recurrent and convolutional networks (LSTM, TCN), and modern deep architectures (N-BEATS, N-HiTS, TFT, PatchTST, Informer). As a factual result, beyond 30 days N-BEATS achieves the lowest MAPE, reaching 8.51% at 365 days versus 14.94% for the best statistical baseline, a 43% reduction; at short horizons (1-7 days), all models converge near 0.72% MAPE and the naive baseline remains competitive. The authors argue that a single N-BEATS model trained at 365 days generalizes to all shorter horizons, eliminating the need for horizon-specific models, and that N-BEATS and N-HiTS show superior hyperparameter stability.
keyPointsEn: At the 365-day horizon, N-BEATS achieves 8.51% MAPE versus 14.94% for the best statistical baseline, a relative reduction of about 43%.
At short horizons (1-7 days), all models converge near 0.72% MAPE and the naive baseline remains competitive.
A single N-BEATS model trained at 365 days generalizes to all shorter horizons, and N-BEATS and N-HiTS show better hyperparameter stability.
cards.limitations: 研究基于波兰在线市场的数据，结论对其他地区、平台或品类的可迁移性尚未验证；仅评估了十一种模型在六个预测期上的表现，未覆盖所有可能架构或外部变量；MAPE等指标对非正态价格分布的适用性需谨慎解读；论文未提供交易成本、库存约束或实际盈利效果的评估，结果不构成投资或定价建议。
cards.descriptionEn: This study establishes the first systematic multi-horizon time-series benchmark for second-hand electronics price forecasting. Using daily listing data from Polish online marketplaces from January 2022 to March 2025, covering over 100 smartphone and laptop models, it compares eleven statistical and deep learning models across six horizons from 1 to 365 days, providing a reproducible evaluation framework for pricing risk management on subscription-based platforms.
cards.summary: 论文对二手电子产品的多期价格预测进行了系统基准测试，覆盖统计模型（ARIMA、ETS、Theta）、循环与卷积网络（LSTM、TCN）以及现代深度架构（N-BEATS、N-HiTS、TFT、PatchTST、Informer）。事实结果是：在超过30天的预测期上，N-BEATS取得最低MAPE，365天时为8.51%，比最佳统计基线14.94%降低43%；在1至7天的短期预测中，所有模型MAPE趋近0.72%，朴素基线仍具竞争力。作者观点认为，单个在365天训练的N-BEATS模型可泛化至所有更短预测期，无需为每个预测期单独建模，且N-BEATS与N-HiTS展示出更优的超参数稳定性。
cards.originalTitle: Deep Learning vs. Statistical Models for Multi-Horizon Price Forecasting of Second-Hand Electronics: A Systematic Benchmark
cards.titleEn: Multi-Horizon Price Forecasting for Second-Hand Electronics: A Systematic Benchmark of Deep Learning and Statistical Models
cards.limitationsEn: The study is based on data from Polish online marketplaces, so transferability to other regions, platforms, or product categories remains unverified; only eleven models across six horizons are evaluated, not all possible architectures or external variables; the suitability of metrics such as MAPE for non-normal price distributions requires cautious interpretation; the paper does not assess transaction costs, inventory constraints, or actual profitability, and the results do not constitute investment or pricing advice.
keyPoints: 在365天预测期上，N-BEATS的MAPE为8.51%，最佳统计基线为14.94%，相对降低约43%。
短期（1至7天）所有模型MAPE趋近0.72%，朴素基线仍具竞争力。
单个365天训练的N-BEATS模型可泛化到所有更短预测期，N-BEATS与N-HiTS超参数稳定性更优。
cards.description: 该研究首次在二手电子产品领域建立多期时间序列预测的系统性基准。使用波兰在线市场2022年1月至2025年3月、100多款手机和笔记本电脑的每日价格数据，系统比较十一种统计与深度学习模型在1至365天六个预测期上的表现，为订阅制平台的定价风险管理提供可复现的评估框架。
cards.title: 二手电子设备多期价格预测：深度学习与统计模型基准对比

cards.whyItMatters: 为Solana DEX上Meme币自动交易提供了首个微观结构测量框架和可复现的审计工具（audit.py），强调在重尾、24/7市场中需谨慎对待累积收益指标，并公开交易日志与拒绝样本语料（CC-BY-4.0），推动该领域的可重复研究。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Provides the first microstructure measurement framework and a reproducible audit tool (audit.py) for autonomous memecoin trading on Solana DEXs, emphasizing caution with cumulative return metrics in heavy-tailed, 24/7 markets, and publicly releases trade logs and rejection-sample corpus (CC-BY-4.0), promoting reproducible research in this area.
cards.summaryEn: The paper reports a 15-day paper-traded autonomous deployment from March 29 to April 12, 2026, with 190 trades. The author claims to observe a 40.5% win rate, mean per-trade return of +0.62%, and cumulative return of +117.7%, but the difference between the three worst entry hours and all others is statistically insignificant (p = 0.5634). Author's view: these findings connect to Kyle (1985) informed-flow, Precup-Sutton-Singh (2000) off-policy evaluation, and Bailey-Lopez de Prado (2014) deflated-Sharpe predictions; the main contribution is measurement infrastructure and three transferable design lessons.
keyPointsEn: The 190-trade sample shows a 40.5% win rate, mean per-trade return of +0.62%, and cumulative return of +117.7%, with skewness -1.21 and excess kurtosis 6.61.

A counterfactual rejection tracker collected 4,874 forward-sample observations; among 48 events observed for at least six hours, 56.25% reached a 50% drawdown (the full-cohort 17.9% is a censored lower bound).
Removing the top three trades (1.6% of the sample) flips cumulative return to unprofitable, highlighting the fragility of small-sample return statistics.
cards.limitations: 仅基于15天、190笔交易的纸面模拟，样本量小且时间窗口短；统计检验为探索性且未确认（p=0.5634）；反事实分析存在删失偏差；累积收益对极端值高度敏感，移除前三笔交易即转负；结论不能推广到其他市场条件或实盘，不构成投资建议。
cards.descriptionEn: This study conducted a 15-day paper-traded autonomous memecoin trading deployment on Solana DEXs, measuring intraday return patterns in a 24/7 market, the net effect of decision-time filter stacks, and the robustness of small-sample cumulative returns. Its novelty lies in filling the measurement gap for AMM venues and providing a reproducible audit script and public data, offering reference value for quantitative trading system design.
cards.summary: 论文报告了一项2026年3月29日至4月12日的15天纸面自动交易部署，共190笔交易。作者声称观察到40.5%胜率、单笔平均收益+0.62%、累积收益+117.7%，但最差三个入场小时与其余小时的收益差异在统计上不显著（p=0.5634）。作者观点：这些发现与Kyle（1985）知情流、Precup-Sutton-Singh（2000）离策略评估及Bailey-Lopez de Prado（2014）紧缩夏普的预测相关，主要贡献是测量基础设施和三条可迁移的设计教训。
cards.originalTitle: Hour-Aware Adaptive Risk Management for Autonomous Memecoin Trading on Solana DEXs: Evidence, Theory, and Design Lessons from a 15-Day Deployment
cards.titleEn: Autonomous Memecoin Trading on Solana DEXs: 15-Day Deployment and Risk Measurement
cards.limitationsEn: Based on only a 15-day, 190-trade paper-traded deployment with a small sample and short time window; statistical test is exploratory and non-confirmatory (p = 0.5634); counterfactual analysis has censoring bias; cumulative return is highly sensitive to extreme values and turns negative when removing the top three trades; findings cannot be generalized to other market conditions or live trading and do not constitute investment advice.
keyPoints: 190笔交易样本显示胜率40.5%、单笔平均收益+0.62%、累积收益+117.7%，但偏度-1.21、超额峰度6.61。
反事实拒绝追踪器收集4,874条前瞻样本，在48个至少观察6小时的事件中，56.25%达到50%回撤（全队列17.9%为删失下界）。
移除前三笔交易（占样本1.6%）即导致累积收益转为亏损，表明小样本收益统计的脆弱性。
cards.description: 该研究在Solana去中心化交易所进行了15天模拟自动交易，测量全天候市场中的日内收益模式、决策时过滤堆叠的净效果以及对小样本累积收益稳健性的检验。其新意在于填补AMM场所缺乏测量的空白，并提供可复现的审计脚本与公开数据，对量化交易系统设计有参考价值。
cards.title: Solana链上Meme币自动交易：15天部署与风险测量

cards.whyItMatters: 在生产ML与量化系统中，代码、配置与制品持续变化而外部反馈不断累积，若把结果证据直接当作因果诊断，容易产生错误归因。该工作为区分可声称的内容与需要额外识别结构才能声称的内容提供了框架，对诊断流程设计和证据审计有参考意义；但它不构成对交易策略或投资价值的建议。
cards.whyItMattersEn: In production ML and quantitative systems, where code, configuration, and artifacts continually change while external feedback accumulates, treating outcome evidence as causal diagnosis can produce faulty attribution. This work offers a framework for separating what can be claimed from what requires additional identification structure, with relevance to diagnostic process design and evidence auditing; it does not constitute advice on trading strategies or investment value.
cards.summaryEn: The paper argues that external feedback can establish that an outcome occurred without identifying which evolving procedure produced it or why. Using a human-directed, agent-engineered quantitative trading system over one year, the account gained and outperformed a broad market index, while annual alpha was not statistically distinguishable from zero under the main retrospective specification; retrospectively selected subperiods showed adverse relative performance and conditional candidate-level weakness under declared approximate references. The authors frame this as an outcome-diagnosis gap and distinguish frozen instances, pre-specified adaptive procedures, and ad-hoc development.
keyPointsEn: Outcome evidence, evaluated-object identity, and causal explanation support distinct claims and cannot substitute for one another.

In the case, annual alpha was indistinguishable from zero and complete recommendation-to-runtime binding was unavailable, so the archive established neither a unique cause nor a common frozen instance.
The authors propose archive-relative claim identifiability, an evidence hierarchy, and a prospective production-binding protocol to constrain what diagnosis can legitimately assert.
cards.limitations: 案例来自单一、人工指导且智能体工程的量化交易系统，结论的外部推广性有限。年度alpha在主要回溯设定下与零不可区分，回溯选取的子区间表现与候选级弱点也依赖声明的近似参照。完整推荐到运行时绑定不可用，归档不确立共同冻结实例或唯一原因。所提前瞻性生产绑定协议仅为提议，尚未经前瞻性验证。
cards.descriptionEn: The study distinguishes outcome evidence, evaluated-object identity, and causal explanation in a continually evolving agent-engineered quantitative trading system, proposing an archive-relative claim identifiability framework, an evidence hierarchy, and a prospective production-binding protocol. Its value lies in delineating operable boundaries for diagnosis in evolving systems and avoiding inferring causes from outcomes alone.
cards.summary: 论文指出，外部反馈能确认结果发生，但未必能识别是哪个演化中的流程产生该结果、以及为何产生。作者以一个人工指导、智能体工程的量化交易系统为案例，一年间账户跑赢宽基指数，但年度alpha在主要回溯设定下与零不可区分；回溯选取的子区间出现相对不利表现，且在声明的近似参照下存在候选级条件弱点。作者由此提出结果—诊断鸿沟，并区分冻结实例、预指定自适应流程与临时开发三种情形。
cards.originalTitle: OOM-RL II: Reality Is an Oracle, Not a Debugger Provenance-Constrained Diagnosis in Continually Evolving Agent-Engineered Systems
cards.titleEn: An Identifiability Gap Between Outcome Evidence and Provenance-Constrained Diagnosis
cards.limitationsEn: The case derives from a single, human-directed, agent-engineered quantitative trading system, limiting external generalizability. Annual alpha was not statistically distinguishable from zero under the main retrospective specification, and retrospectively selected subperiod performance and candidate-level weaknesses depend on declared approximate references. Complete recommendation-to-runtime binding was unavailable, and the archive establishes neither a common frozen instance nor a unique cause. The proposed prospective production-binding protocol is a proposal, not prospectively validated.
keyPoints: 外部结果证据、被评估对象身份与因果解释分别支撑不同主张，不能互相替代。
案例中年度alpha与零不可区分，且完整推荐到运行时绑定不可用，归档无法确立唯一原因或共同冻结实例。
作者提出归档相对主张可识别性、证据层级与前瞻性生产绑定协议，用于约束诊断的可讨论范围。
cards.description: 该研究在持续演化的智能体工程量化交易系统中，区分了外部结果证据、被评估对象身份与因果解释三类主张，提出证据层级与归档相对可识别性框架，并给出前瞻性生产绑定协议；其价值在于为演化系统中的归因诊断划定可操作边界，避免用结果反推原因。
cards.title: 真实结果与归因诊断之间存在可识别性鸿沟

cards.whyItMatters: 该基准为量化研究提供了关于算法拒绝交易事件及其后续结果的大规模、结构化数据，有助于理解交易过滤机制的影响，并支持开发更稳健的风险管理和策略评估。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This benchmark provides large-scale, structured data on algorithmically-rejected trading events and their outcomes for quantitative research, aiding understanding of the impact of trading filters and supporting development of more robust risk management and strategy evaluation.
cards.summaryEn: RED-2400 is a public benchmark of 6,660 algorithmically-rejected trading events, of which 3,333 link to post-rejection price-and-liquidity sample series. It provides 169,123 forward-outcome observations and 1,837 lifecycle snapshots. The author notes that the 'gone' state in the lifecycle tracker does not denote token death or a rug pull, and filter labels are anonymized while liquidity and volume are quantized to protect operational thresholds. This is the first window of a planned series, with subsequent windows extending the time horizon for regime-stratified analysis.
keyPointsEn: Contains 6,660 algorithmically-rejected trading events, with 50.05% linked to post-rejection price-and-liquidity sample series.
Provides 169,123 forward-outcome observations and 1,837 lifecycle snapshots, covering 1,076 distinct mints.
Filter labels are anonymized to filter_1 through filter_8, and liquidity and 24-hour volume are quantized to the nearest power of two to prevent operational-threshold inference.
cards.limitations: 该数据集不包含结果标签列，且作者撤回了关于“早期死亡”与代币死亡关系的分析，因为大多数早期死亡事件在10.5分钟内被重新拒绝，表明该标签标记的是重新拒绝时间而非代币死亡。此外，“gone”状态并非终态，167个代币在进入该状态后恢复为alive状态。数据集仅覆盖22天，可能无法代表更长的市场周期。
cards.descriptionEn: This benchmark discloses 6,660 algorithmically-rejected trading events from a Solana DEX filter stack, observed continuously over 22 days, providing forward-outcome observations and lifecycle snapshots to support research on rejected trading events.
cards.summary: RED-2400是一个公开基准，包含6,660个算法拒绝交易事件，其中3,333个事件关联了拒绝后的价格与流动性样本序列，并提供了169,123条前向结果观测和1,837条生命周期快照。作者指出，生命周期追踪文件中的“gone”状态并不表示代币死亡或跑路，且过滤器的标签被匿名化处理，流动性及交易量数据经过量化以保护操作阈值隐私。该基准是系列研究的第一窗口，后续将扩展时间范围以支持制度分层分析。
cards.originalTitle: RED-2400: A Public Benchmark of Algorithmically-Rejected Trading Events with Outcome Labels
cards.titleEn: RED-2400: A Public Benchmark of Algorithmically-Rejected Trading Events with Outcome Labels
cards.limitationsEn: The dataset contains no outcome-label column, and the author withdraws the analysis of 'early-death' versus token death because most early-death events were re-rejected within 10.5 minutes, indicating the label marks re-rejection timing rather than token death. Additionally, the 'gone' state is not terminal, as 167 mints later returned to an alive state. The dataset covers only 22 days and may not represent longer market cycles.
keyPoints: 包含6,660个算法拒绝交易事件，其中50.05%关联了拒绝后的价格与流动性样本序列。
提供了169,123条前向结果观测和1,837条生命周期快照，覆盖1,076个不同的代币铸造地址。
过滤标签被匿名化为filter_1至filter_8，流动性及24小时交易量被量化为最近的2的幂次，以防操作阈值推断。
cards.description: 该基准公开了来自Solana去中心化交易所过滤栈的6,660个算法拒绝交易事件，覆盖22天连续观测，提供前向结果观测和生命周期快照，旨在支持被拒绝交易事件的研究。
cards.title: RED-2400：算法拒绝交易事件的公开基准与标签

cards.whyItMatters: 离散选择模型的设定通常依赖建模者反复试错，Delphos 提供了一种自适应、学习驱动的辅助思路，可能降低开发与细化效用函数的成本。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Discrete choice model specification often relies on repeated trial and error by the modeller; Delphos offers an adaptive, learning-based approach that may reduce the effort required to develop and refine utility functions.
cards.summaryEn: The authors introduce Delphos, a deep reinforcement learning framework for assisting discrete choice model specification by treating specification as a sequence of modelling decisions. An agent generates candidate models through actions such as adding constants, setting preference parameters, applying non-linear transformations, and including interactions, with each candidate evaluated by a modeller-defined reward function. Experiments on simulated and two empirical datasets show that Delphos learns effective specification strategies while exploring only a small fraction of the feasible modelling space and produces competitive models.
keyPointsEn: Delphos frames model specification as a sequential decision-making problem and uses a Deep Q-Network to learn sequences of modelling actions.
The reward function is defined by the modeller and can reflect both statistical model fit and behavioural expectations.
On simulated data and two empirical datasets, Delphos explores only a small fraction of the feasible space and generates competitive, behaviourally plausible models.
cards.limitations: 证据主要来自作者在模拟和两个实证数据集上的实验，尚不能说明该方法在所有数据、模型类型或奖励函数下都普遍有效。奖励函数由建模者定义，因此结果依赖其设定；论文展示的是辅助模型设定的潜力，而非替代建模者判断或直接给出最终模型。
cards.descriptionEn: This study proposes Delphos, which frames discrete choice model specification as a sequential decision-making problem and uses a Deep Q-Network to learn sequences of modelling actions, reducing manual trial and error. Its usefulness lies in generating competitive and behaviourally plausible candidate models while exploring only a small part of the feasible space.
cards.summary: 作者提出 Delphos，一个用于辅助离散选择模型设定的深度强化学习框架，把模型设定视为一系列建模决策。智能体通过添加常数、设置偏好参数、应用非线性变换和引入交互项等动作生成候选模型，并以建模者定义的奖励函数评估估计结果。在模拟和两个实证数据集上的实验显示，Delphos 能在搜索空间较小部分内学得有效设定策略并产生有竞争力的模型。
cards.originalTitle: Delphos: A reinforcement learning framework for assisting discrete choice model specification
cards.titleEn: Delphos: A Reinforcement Learning Framework for Assisting Discrete Choice Model Specification
cards.limitationsEn: The evidence comes mainly from the authors' experiments on simulated data and two empirical datasets, so it does not establish that the method is generally effective across all datasets, model types, or reward functions. The reward function is modeller-defined, so results depend on that specification. The paper demonstrates the potential of assisting model specification, not replacing modeller judgment or directly producing a final model.
keyPoints: Delphos 将模型设定建模为顺序决策问题，使用深度 Q 网络学习建模动作序列。
奖励函数由建模者定义，可同时反映统计拟合与行为预期。
在模拟数据和两个实证数据集上，Delphos 能探索较小部分可行空间并生成有竞争力、行为合理的模型。
cards.description: 该研究提出 Delphos，将离散选择模型的设定过程建模为顺序决策问题，用深度 Q 网络学习建模动作序列，以减少人工试错。其有用性在于可在少量搜索内生成具有竞争力且行为合理的候选模型。
cards.title: Delphos：强化学习辅助离散选择模型设定

cards.whyItMatters: 若该方法可行，可能降低逆向分析的门槛并提升重复性任务效率；但当前仅凭项目描述，尚无法判断其实际能力与适用范围，读者应等待代码与文档披露后再评估。
cards.whyItMattersEn: If the approach works, it could lower barriers to reverse engineering and improve efficiency on repetitive tasks; however, with only a project description, its actual capabilities and scope cannot be judged until code and documentation are available.
cards.summaryEn: GitHub trending project rea positions itself as using agents to reverse engineer anything, from app behavior to native binaries. Its value lies in automating reverse engineering rather than relying purely on manual analysis. Only a brief description is public, so its methods and results cannot yet be verified.
keyPointsEn: The project aims to reverse engineer app behavior and native binaries using agents.
It sits at the intersection of AI tools and reverse engineering as a GitHub trending project.
Only a one-line description is public, with no technical implementation or validation details.
cards.limitations: 输入仅包含项目名称与一句描述，没有作者、论文、基准测试或代码细节；无法确认其支持的目标类型、分析深度、准确率与安全合规性。所有结论仅限于对项目定位的理解，不构成任何投资或使用建议。
cards.descriptionEn: The project proposes agent-driven reverse engineering spanning application behavior down to native binaries, offering a new angle for automating reverse engineering workflows.
cards.summary: GitHub 趋势项目 rea 定位为用智能体对任意目标进行逆向工程，范围从应用行为延伸到原生二进制。其价值主张在于把逆向分析过程交给智能体自动化，而非依赖纯手工操作。由于仅有简要介绍，尚无公开细节可验证其具体方法与效果。

cards.title: rea 项目：用智能体逆向分析应用与二进制

cards.whyItMatters: 当 AI 代理参与技术文档和图表生成时，缺乏设计规范容易导致输出风格杂乱、质量参差。该仓库提供了一套可复用的设计约束，有助于提升代理生成图表的专业性和统一性，减少人工调整成本。
cards.whyItMattersEn: When AI agents are involved in generating technical documents and diagrams, the lack of design standards often leads to inconsistent and uneven output. This repository offers a reusable set of design constraints that can enhance the professionalism and consistency of agent-generated diagrams, reducing manual adjustment costs.
cards.summaryEn: This repository defines a diagram design rule set for coding agents, supporting 42 diagram types with self-contained HTML+SVG output while prohibiting shadows and rough Mermaid-generated charts. Its value lies in providing unified design constraints for agents, but the repository lacks empirical evaluations or independent verification data.
keyPointsEn: Provides diagram design guidance for agents including Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Factory Droid, and Pi.
Supports 42 diagram types, all rendered as self-contained HTML+SVG.
The design rules explicitly exclude shadow effects and Mermaid-generated diagrams.
cards.limitations: 仓库未包含对 42 种图表类型的实际生成质量测试、用户反馈或与 Mermaid 的对比数据；其设计规则是否适用于所有代理或场景尚未验证；禁止阴影和 Mermaid 属于作者主观偏好，未说明依据。
cards.descriptionEn: This repository provides editorial diagram design rules for coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, and GitHub Copilot. It covers 42 diagram types, outputs self-contained HTML+SVG, and explicitly rejects shadows and low-quality Mermaid diagrams, aiming to improve professionalism and consistency of agent-generated diagrams.
cards.summary: 该仓库定义了一套面向编码代理的图表设计规则，支持 42 种图表类型，输出自包含 HTML+SVG，并禁止阴影与 Mermaid 生成的粗糙图表。其价值在于为代理提供统一的设计约束，但仓库未提供实际效果评测或独立验证数据。
cards.titleEn: Open-Source Repository for Structured Diagram Design in Coding Agents
cards.limitationsEn: The repository does not include empirical quality tests of the 42 diagram types, user feedback, or comparative data against Mermaid; the applicability of its design rules across all agents or scenarios is unverified; the prohibitions on shadows and Mermaid are subjective preferences without stated justification.
keyPoints: 针对 Claude Code、Codex、GitHub Copilot、Factory Droid、Pi 等代理提供图表设计指导。
支持 42 种图表类型，均以自包含 HTML+SVG 格式呈现。
设计准则明确排除阴影效果和 Mermaid 生成的图表。
cards.description: 该仓库为 Claude Code、Codex、GitHub Copilot 等编码代理提供一套明确编辑风格的图表设计规则，涵盖 42 种图表类型，采用自包含 HTML+SVG 输出，明确反对阴影效果和低质量 Mermaid 图，旨在提升代理生成图表的专业性和一致性。
cards.title: 为编码代理提供结构化图表设计的开源仓库

cards.whyItMatters: 代码审查是软件质量保障的关键环节，混合架构试图兼顾规则检测的可重复性与 LLM 的语义理解能力，若可落地，可能降低大规模团队的人工审查负担。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Code review is a key part of software quality assurance, and the hybrid approach attempts to combine the reproducibility of rule-based checks with the semantic understanding of LLMs. If viable, it could reduce manual review burden for large teams.
cards.summaryEn: The repository presents a code review tool described as battle-tested at Alibaba's scale, using a hybrid architecture of deterministic pipelines plus an LLM agent. It claims to be secure, fast, and efficient, supporting precise line-level comments and a built-in multi-language ruleset. These are claims from the source summary, with no quantitative benchmarks or independent reproduction evidence provided.
keyPointsEn: Hybrid architecture: deterministic pipelines handle stable rule-based checks, while the LLM agent adds semantic-level review.
Supports precise line-level comments, with a built-in multi-language ruleset covering patterns such as NPE, thread safety, XSS, and SQL injection.
Compatible with OpenAI and Anthropic interfaces for integration with existing model services.
cards.limitations: 当前信息仅来自 GitHub Trending 摘要，未提供检测准确率、误报率、性能数据或与同类工具的对照评测；'在阿里巴巴规模下经过验证'属于来源主张，缺乏可核验细节与独立复现；规则集覆盖范围与实际漏报情况未知；对 LLM 接口的依赖可能带来成本、延迟与数据隐私方面的约束。
cards.descriptionEn: The tool combines deterministic review pipelines with an LLM agent to produce precise line-level comments, and ships with a multi-language ruleset covering null pointer, thread-safety, XSS, and SQL injection issues. Its value lies in offering a more controllable, reusable automation approach for large-scale code review, with OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible interfaces.
cards.summary: 该仓库介绍了一个在阿里巴巴规模下经过验证的代码审查工具，采用确定性流水线与 LLM Agent 的混合架构。仓库声称其安全、快速、高效，支持行级精确评论，并内置多语言规则集。以上均为来源摘要中的主张，未提供量化基准或独立复现证据。
cards.titleEn: Alibaba Open-Sources Code Review Tool with Hybrid Deterministic Pipeline and LLM Agent Architecture
cards.limitationsEn: The available information comes only from a GitHub Trending summary; it provides no detection accuracy, false-positive rate, performance data, or comparative evaluation against similar tools. The claim of being 'battle-tested at Alibaba's scale' is a source assertion without verifiable details or independent reproduction. The ruleset's coverage and actual miss rate are unknown. Dependence on LLM interfaces may introduce constraints around cost, latency, and data privacy.
keyPoints: 混合架构：确定性流水线负责稳定规则检测，LLM Agent 补充语义级审查。
支持行级精确评论，内置多语言规则集，覆盖 NPE、线程安全、XSS、SQL 注入等模式。
兼容 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 接口，便于接入现有模型服务。
cards.description: 该工具将确定性审查流水线与 LLM Agent 结合，在代码行级给出精确评论，并内置多语言规则集覆盖空指针、线程安全、XSS、SQL 注入等常见缺陷。其用处在于为大规模代码审查提供更可控、可复用的自动化方案，且兼容 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 接口。
cards.title: 阿里开源代码审查工具：确定性流水线结合LLM智能体的混合架构
